comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab and doc/manual.md in the same tree. All four knobs are 0 to 1 shown as a percentage; rate, depth and mix default to the middle and feedback to zero. The rate knob is the exponent of both LFO sweeps at once, 0.005Hz to 5Hz for the slow pair and 0.5Hz to 40Hz for the fast pair. The feedback amount is 0.39 times the square root of the knob. Each channel runs two bucket-brigade delay lines of 4096 stages with a 12000Hz anti-aliasing filter after them and a 240Hz high-pass in the feedback path, and the four sweeps start at phases of minus a third of pi, zero, zero and a third of pi. The input is summed into the feedback through a hyperbolic tangent after being scaled by 0.075.
